name: Gyan Bot
description: A Telegram-based academic assistant that delivers university PDFs and study resources for CHARUSAT students. Built with Node.js and webhook integrations, the bot automates document access and provides a streamlined academic support experience. Deployed on Vercel for fast performance and reliable availability.

name: RentEase ERP
description: A full-stack ERP-based rental management platform built to streamline rental business operations. The system includes three role-based login panels (Admin, Vendor, and Customer), enabling secure access and management. It also features a customer-facing e-commerce platform where users can browse and rent products online. The backend is built with Express.js, handling authentication, role-based authorization, product management, order processing, and API services.

name: BigO Buddy
